# Provenance

- Dataset: “Opening the Box to Explore the Contents” All raw data
- Creator: Xuanrui Huang
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.30671120.v1
- License: CC BY 4.0
- Downloaded: 2026-08-29
- Files used: the 8,624-review summary, three coder workbooks, and the published crawler code

The review workbook has 8,624 rows and 8,107 unique comment texts. It contains a masked username
and a sequential `page` field but no product ID or review timestamp. Processed outputs exclude the
masked username. The three coder files provide multi-label design categories, not sentiment.
